evidence: Resting subset in Conkin Table III and original Thompson Sections 2–2.1 both report 549 records, 96 female and 453 male records, with 124 Grade IV detections. Thompson removes one male Grade IV record with a 104-minute interval after equipment failure. Its Tables 2a–2d therefore give 123/548.

Conkin Table IV and NASA/TP-2004-213158 Table 9 name the same seven phases and agree on 217 exposure records, 30 DCS, 94 any VGE and 22 Grade IV VGE. Both include two Phase I cases reported after exposure. The exercise-only report also describes additional analysis cohorts.
